scene: The locker door swings open, revealing secret transit passes and hidden tunnels.
picture: A wide subterranean station cavern lined with bath tiles. Far left, an open locker reveals a shiny rail platform with a red express car. Centre, the grandfather in navy apron stands holding his bicycle. Far right, an orange koi boat bobs in tiled water. Up high, a mossy tram rests on tracks.
shown: A steaming red railway car parked at an open track platform, left side
A giant orange koi-shaped boat idling in an indoor canal slip, far right
A vine-covered green cable tram resting on an inclined rail track, up high
